activities.activity_description: Review existing Spring XD modules (json-to-tuple, object-to-json, script, shell, splitter) and plan adaptation strategies for Spring Cloud Stream integration, including design decisions and dependency management.
Adapt the json-to-tuple module from Spring XD to function as a processor in Spring Cloud Stream, including code refactoring, dependency updates, and basic unit testing.
Adapt the object-to-json module from Spring XD to function as a processor in Spring Cloud Stream, with similar code adjustments and testing as other modules.
Adapt the script module from Spring XD, which may involve scripting engine integration, to function as a processor in Spring Cloud Stream, including configuration and testing.
Adapt the shell module from Spring XD, potentially involving command-line or shell integration, to function as a processor in Spring Cloud Stream, with thorough testing.
Adapt the splitter module from Spring XD for data splitting logic to function as a processor in Spring Cloud Stream, including performance considerations and testing.
Research and prototype options to remove composed job from Spring XD to clean up unused resources and reduce memory footprints, documenting findings and initial implementation.

activities.activity_name: Explore ZK Metadata for Composed Job
activities.activity_description: Research and prototype saving composed job definitions in ZooKeeper metadata to enable job recreation for failure recovery, including design and proof-of-concept code.
Create a BinderFactory abstraction to support multiple binder types in Spring Cloud Stream, involving interface design, implementation, and unit tests.
Conduct comprehensive integration testing for all ported modules and new features to ensure compatibility, performance, and correctness in a streaming pipeline context.
Write technical documentation for ported modules and new features, perform code cleanup, and facilitate code reviews to maintain code quality.
